_comment: The Stage-3 field whitelist. This file is the single source of both the
JSON Schema sent to the model and the instructions that accompany it, so
a new fact type is an entry here and no change to any Python file.
JSON rather than the YAML plan §9 sketched: the project declares no
runtime dependencies, and adding PyYAML to read six field descriptions
would make every install and every test pay for it.
Rules for adding a field. It must be something a human could point to in
the post with a finger. If answering it requires knowing the industry,
estimating, or reading between the lines, it is a judgment and belongs in
Bump `version` on any change. It is the prompt_version stored against
every extracted value, and it is what makes a re-run replace its own
earlier output instead of duplicating it.

fields.name: geo
fields.description: Country, region or city names the post explicitly targets or reports on, exactly as written (e.g. 'RU', 'Тир 1', 'Бразилия'). Do not infer a geo from language, currency or brand.

fields.name: brand
fields.description: Named brands, products, apps or advertisers mentioned by name. Copy the name as written. Do not include the channel's own name.

fields.name: offer
fields.description: The offer or vertical, only when the post names it in so many words (e.g. 'гемблинг', 'нутра', 'дейтинг'). Null unless it is stated.

fields.name: kpis
fields.description: Performance metrics stated with their values, copied whole (e.g. 'CR 12%', 'ROI 140%', 'CPI $0.8'). Include the metric name and the number together. Do not compute or convert anything.

fields.name: dates
fields.description: Dates and date ranges written in the post, exactly as written (e.g. '15 марта', 'Q2 2026'). Do not resolve relative expressions like 'вчера' into a calendar date.

fields.name: amounts
fields.description: Money amounts and budgets with their currency, exactly as written (e.g. '$5000', '300к руб'). Do not convert currencies or sum anything.
